help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: How ordering on NoboSole works
help.exact12Q: Why must I allocate exactly 12 pairs?
help.exact12A: One dozen is 12 pairs. Every pack is made to order, so you decide how those 12 pairs are divided across the sizes and colours you picked.
help.scalingQ: I increased the quantity — why does it ask for 24 pairs now?
help.scalingA: The total scales with the order: 2 dozen is 24 pairs, 3 dozen is 36. The split you already made is kept and scaled up, so you only adjust it if you want a different mix.
help.minTwoQ: Why does every size need at least 2 pairs?
help.minTwoA: Production runs in pairs of two. A size with a single pair cannot be manufactured, so each size in a pack takes a minimum of 2 pairs.
help.moqA: The minimum number of dozens you must order of a shoe. It is counted across every pack of that shoe in your cart, not per pack — so two packs of 1 dozen each already satisfy an MOQ of 2 dozen.
help.blockedA: Either a shoe has not reached its MOQ, or a pack no longer matches that product's current colour and size rules. The cart shows a red note on the line that needs attention — open it with Edit and rebuild the pack.
help.editQ: How do I change the colour, size or quantity after adding to the cart?
help.editA: Open the Cart tab and tap Edit on that line. The pack builder reopens with your current selection, and saving replaces the line.
help.perDozenQ: Why are prices shown per dozen?
help.perDozenA: NoboSole is wholesale only. Every price is for one dozen — 12 pairs — and the cart multiplies it by the number of dozens you ordered.
help.methodsQ: Which payment methods can I use?
help.methodsA: Cash on Delivery, where you pay when the order arrives, or Bank Transfer.
help.bankQ: When do I get the bank transfer details?
help.bankA: After you place the order. The transfer instructions are sent to you, and the order stays Unpaid until your transfer is confirmed.
help.paymentStatusQ: What do Unpaid, Partially paid and Paid mean?
help.paymentStatusA: Unpaid — nothing received yet. Partially paid — part of the amount has arrived and a balance is outstanding. Paid — settled in full. The Expense Tracker lists every payment and what is still owed.
help.optionsA: Standard arrives in 3–5 business days, Express in 1–2 business days, and Pickup is ready for collection within 24 hours.
help.orderStatusQ: What do the order statuses mean?
help.orderStatusA: Pending — received, not yet confirmed. Confirmed — accepted. Processing — being made. Packed — ready to leave. Shipped — on the way to you. Delivered — completed.
help.cancelA: Open My Orders and use Cancel order. Once an order is Shipped it can no longer be cancelled in the app — contact support instead.
help.detailsQ: Why do you ask for my shop name and trade licence?
help.detailsA: NoboSole sells wholesale to registered businesses. These details confirm you are a trade buyer and are used on your invoices and delivery paperwork.
help.settingsQ: How do I change the language or switch to dark mode?
help.settingsA: Go to Profile → Settings. Language switches the whole app between English and Bangla, and Theme switches between light and dark.
help.expensesA: Profile → Expense Tracker shows what you have paid, what each order cost, and how much is still outstanding.
help.stillStuckBody: If your question is not answered here, message the NoboSole team on WhatsApp and someone will help you directly.
